_comment: Stations whose departures and arrivals are collected every 10 minutes on weekdays. Data from Trafiklab (CC-BY 4.0).

train_filter._note: All trains (Öresundståg and Pågatåg) are kept; both are covered by Skånetrafiken's delay compensation.

compensation_rules._source: Skånetrafiken/Öresundståg terms + Lag (2015:953): 50% at 20-39 min, 75% at 40-59 min, 100% at 60+ min delay at final destination
